title: The Right Dissenter and the right to resume
description: TLDR: Can repaired evidence memory preserve a correct stop and reopen when facts improve? Compare original and symmetric Jev admission on identical repaired mechanics with always-check, majority, pooled evidence and an exact rule. Measure all 576 assigned decisions, recovery, false reversals, duplicate-check waste and calls/checks. Scripted votes and 24 fixed template roots limit inference; exploratory RD-4 successor.
